links.outcome: Source of psychiatrists' AI knowledge (structured versus informal)
links.effect: Psychiatrists reported broad exposure to AI, but knowledge was largely acquired through informal rather than structured sources; limited access to formal training was noted.
links.quote: Psychiatrists reported broad exposure to AI, though knowledge was largely acquired through informal rather than structured sources.

screen.reason: The study is an empirical cross-sectional survey evaluating psychiatrist readiness, trust, and design expectations for AI in psychiatric practice.
